Spore_Cloud_Gliding_Membranes.description: Emerging from the twisted fungal flesh of the entity, the Spore_Cloud_Gliding_Membranes are translucent wings, veined with dark, pulsating tendrils that release a toxic spore cloud when disturbed, granting the entity both aerial mobility and a deadly defensive mechanism.

Bioluminescent_Fairy_Wings.description: Glowing with an ethereal light, these delicate fungal wings sprout from the wearer’s back, granting them the ability to hover and fly through the darkest of forests, while also enhancing their wisdom and charisma, and bestowing them with the skills to levitate and emit a soft, guiding light.

Puffing_Mycelial_Gas_Bladders.description: Emerging from the entity’s back are semi-translucent, fungal bladders filled with a noxious, puffing mycelial gas, granting it the ability to hover eerily above the ground while releasing a toxic mist that can incapacitate foes and resist poison itself.

Parasitic_Insectoid_Host_Wings.description: Emerging from the corrupted flesh of its host, this pair of iridescent fungal wings pulsates with an eerie luminescence, granting the host unparalleled agility and grace in the air, a stark contrast to the blight they symbolize.

Decaying_Leathery_Bat_Like_Wings.description: These leathery wings, resembling those of a bat but twisted by fungal corruption, flap with an eerie grace, granting their undead-like bearer the ability to soar through the air while instilling fear and resistance to the forces that would otherwise disrupt their flight.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Gliders.description: The Hardened Shelf Fungus Gliders are bizarre, fungal entities with thick, leathery wings that allow them to glide silently through the air, their natural armor providing a protective shield that comes at the cost of agility, yet granting them the ability to block attacks and traverse rugged terrain with ease.

Slime_Mold_Gossamer_Wings.description: The Slime_Mold_Gossamer_Wings are delicate, iridescent appendages that unfurl from the fungal spores of a rare, sentient slime mold, granting the bearer swift, agile flight through even the thorniest terrain, while also enhancing their evasion and agility.

Vibrant_Amanita_Capped_Wings.description: Borne from the twisted spires of the Fungal Wastes, the Vibrant Amanita-Capped Wings are a marvel of dark bioluminescence and eerie charm, granting their bearer the ability to glide through the night skies while exuding an alluring poison that can captivate and corrupt those who dare to draw near.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Wings.description: Emerging from the shadowed depths of the Underdark, the crystalline wings are a haunting blend of dark fungal growths encased in shimmering, iridescent crystals, granting their bearer both the wisdom to navigate the treacherous caverns and the resilience to endure the harsh conditions, while also enabling silent flight and the ability to reflect harmful spells back upon their caster.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Wings.description: The Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Wings are translucent, ethereal appendages that sprout from the entity's back, granting it the ability to hover and fly silently through the air. These fungal wings are imbued with a spectral essence, enhancing the entity's stealth and wisdom, while also bestowing it with the unique skills of levitation and ethereal sight.
